_notes: mode=chat-audio: POST <base_url>/chat/completions with base64 input_audio (Gemini via OpenAI-compatible gateways).
mode=command: run this shell command; {wav} is replaced by the recording path, else the path is appended.
Tested on cnapi.kksj.org: gemini-3.1-flash-lite ($0.000092/req), gemini-3.5-flash-lite ($0.000128/req), gemini-3-flash-preview ($0.000184/req).
GPT/whisper ASR models exist there but currently return HTTP 429 upstream_rate_limit.
proxy: optional, e.g. http://100.64.0.30:7890 (the Mac's Clash) if capu can't reach the API directly.
audio_format=mp3 converts the recording with ffmpeg (43KB instead of 221KB for 6s); wav keeps the raw file.
max_record_seconds caps a toggle recording; the client retries transient curl failures twice.
prompt empty = built-in chat/terminal prompt (filler removal, hotwords, numbers, self-corrections).
prompt_mode: chat (message to a coding agent) or terminal (shell command, no trailing period).
Set enabled=true after filling the fields; test with: cardputer-pager --voice-test --wav file.wav
